description: Source code for resetting a boot counter on Linksys devices using MTD flash memory, including functions for reading, erasing, and writing boot counter data.

classes.name: bootcounter
classes.description: Structure representing the boot counter data stored in flash memory.

methods.name: mtd_resetbc
methods.description: Resets the boot counter stored in the specified MTD device, erasing and rewriting the counter data.
